narrative: On the bookwheel. A ballad sheet in the seller's hand, not in his. A woodcut of a ship. The letters rubbed down. City side of the stair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked, and did not take the sheet.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Walked up with him. He did not buy it either.

entities.name: the ballad sheet
entities.context: Shown on pamphlet in The same ship
